title: Strategy Pattern
description: Define a family of algorithms, encapsulate each one, and make them interchangeable.

data.text: The **Strategy Pattern** defines a family of algorithms, encapsulates each one, and makes them interchangeable. It lets the algorithm vary independently from clients that use it.

data.title: Strategy Pattern
Key Takeaways
points: Eliminates conditional statements for selecting behaviors
Algorithms can be swapped at runtime
data.takeaway: Use Strategy Pattern when you need different variants of an algorithm.
